summary: Quantifies disruption of scene–bump phase alignment across learning epochs using circular offsets and within-subject out-of-phase fractions.
use_when: quantify scene–bump alignment disruption across learning epochs
calculate the fraction of time a neural bump is out of phase
compare circular phase offsets within subjects
visualize pre-learning, learning, and post-learning alignment
analyze cognitive-map stability from angular time series
avoid_when: Neural and behavioral measurements cannot be aligned on a common time base
The intended conclusion requires causal inference from an observational association alone
